assetNotes: NotebookLM infographic generation failed twice with RPC CREATE_ARTIFACT. Both daily infographics were regenerated with the built-in imagegen workflow in the early-May hand-drawn editorial style, then regenerated again after the OpenAI policy item was replaced by Every's enterprise AI implementation item so the industry quadrant matched the final text.

Audio was generated with npm run radar:audio and --no-keep-notebook. The first zh wait hung and was terminated before a clean retry; the retry produced /audio/radar/daily-ai-radar-2026-06-02.mp3. The ja run produced /audio/radar/daily-ai-radar-2026-06-02.ja.mp3.
R2 was not configured in this environment, so daily audio URLs remained local public/audio paths.
